items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: How long did he play with you? ... At least a year, off and on, when I was working. John Handy, I liked John Handy on tenor.

ctx.x: Well, the way I heard it, that they kept you waiting forever while George Handy was on, or something like that. And you finally got on --
John Handy, right. And when you finally got on, it was so late that the people were leaving and you got angry, or something like that.
